local_development_install: codex-cli 0.164.0 at ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.19.0/bin/codex (matches the pinned version; local runs use an isolated CODEX_HOME and never touch the user's real ~/.codex state)
pin_policy: Resolve GitHub stable release and npm latest together before a campaign; pin version, release commit and package integrity for its duration. The dereferenced tag commit above was resolved via git ls-remote on 2026-10-27 and must be re-verified by the campaign target tool before any formal execution.
notes: Codex release tags use the rust-v<version> format, unlike the v<version> format of the OpenClaw campaign; parameterized validators must accept this format instead of hard-coding v+version.
The npm package ships the prebuilt Rust binary; installation verification uses `codex --version` output (codex-cli <version>) instead of a JS build-info file.
node_engine '>=16' does not select an exact Node version; formal runners pin one explicit Node major (recorded per run) exactly like the OpenClaw campaign pinned Node for its engine range.
